newsitem.title: HONG KONG: ASIL completes HK$213 mln China deal.
newsitem.headline: ASIL completes HK$213 mln China deal.

text.p: Asia Securities International Ltd said on Sunday it had completed its HK$213.36 million acquisition of the development rights to three sites in Beijing.
The deal, involving a total site area of 20,000 square metres and a gross floor area of 195,000 square metres in the Wangfujing district, was completed on Friday, it said in a statement.
The purchase was made through the acquisition of the equity interest of two wholly owned subsidiaries of Hongkong China Ltd which held the development rights, it said.
Asia Securities would satisfy the payment HK$213.36 million by issuing new share and convertible loan notes.
But the statement did not give the number of shares and notes to be issued.

The company had said in June the purchase would be funded by issuing 29 million new shares at HK$1.84 each, and HK$160 million unsecured loan notes convertible into Asia Securities shares at HK$1.84, subject to adjustment.
Asia Securities is engaged mainly in property investment and management, investment holding and securities trading.
